notes:
Sales GST Summary — fixes:

• Fixed a crash: running the summary over a wide date range could crash Tally itself ("Memory Access Violation") — data is now pulled month-by-month behind the scenes instead of in one large request, so it stays reliable no matter how wide a range you pick.

• Works for any company now: the page has its own Company dropdown (every company currently open in Tally) instead of being locked to whichever company the rest of Tally Suite happens to have selected.
